name: Document General Information 5
definition: General information that unambiguously identifies a document, such as identification number and issue date time.

DocumentType.name: Document Type
DocumentType.definition: Specifies the type of the document, for example commercial invoice.

SenderReceiverSequenceIdentification.name: Sender Receiver Sequence Identification
SenderReceiverSequenceIdentification.definition: Specifies the identification sequence number for a specific couple sender/receiver.

URL.name: URL
URL.definition: URL (Uniform Resource Locator) where the document can be found.

LinkFileHash.name: Link File Hash
LinkFileHash.definition: Full Signature Structure without Signature itself:|Hash + Certificate.

AttachedBinaryFile.name: Attached Binary File
AttachedBinaryFile.definition: Attached binary file for this document.
